description: Na₄SrU₃O₁₂ crystallizes in the cubic Im̅3m space group. Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form distorted NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent SrO₆ octahedra, and faces with six equivalent UO₆ octahedra. There are six shorter (3.07 Å) and six longer (3.08 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Sr is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form SrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent UO₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sr-O bond lengths are 2.40 Å. U is bonded to six O atoms to form UO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SrO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent UO₆ octahedra, and faces with eight equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (1.94 Å) and four longer (2.17 Å) U-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to four equivalent Na and two equivalent U atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to four equivalent Na, one Sr, and one U atom.
